items.title: Scheffler retains lead in Memphis as Burns stars and McIlroy toils again
items.description: Scottie Scheffler will take a two-shot lead into the final round of the FedEx St Jude Championship in Memphis as he looks to complete his first win since January.

items.title: Djokovic knocked out early in Cincinnati after struggling in sapping heat
items.description: Novak Djokovic suffered defeat and struggled physically in his first match since Wimbledon as he was upset by Thiago Agustin Tirante in a sapping three-set contest at the Cincinnati Open.

items.title: Man City latest: Maresca confirms club captains 'for now'
Papers: Lille head coach confirms Man City's Bouaddi talks
items.description: The top stories and transfer rumours from Sunday's newspapers...

items.title: Tributes paid to Tarling following British cyclist's death during Volta a Portugal
items.description: Tributes were paid to Finlay Tarling at the Volta a Portugal after the 19-year-old British cyclist died during the race on Friday.

items.title: Villa begin Suzuki talks - Sunday's gossip
items.description: Aston Villa are in negotiations over Zion Suzuki, boosting Juventus' hope of signing Emiliano Martinez, while Arsenal are told price for Victor Osimhen, plus more.

items.title: West Ham break EFL record to sign Engels for £22m
items.description: West Ham United pay a £22m fee, a new EFL record, to sign Celtic's Belgium international midfielder Arne Engels.

items.title: West Ham break EFL record to sign Engels from Celtic for £22m
items.description: West Ham United pay a £22m fee, a new EFL record, to sign Celtic's Belgium international midfielder Arne Engels.

items.title: St Helens keep slim play-off hopes alive by stunning Wakefield
items.description: St Helens produced a blistering second-half performance to stun Wakefield Trinity with a 46-16 victory and keep their slim Super League play-off hopes alive.

items.title: Celtic ease into League Cup quarters - Aberdeen, Kilmarnock & Ross Co also through
items.description: A round-up from the Scottish League Cup as Celtic eased through to the quarter-finals with 4-0 victory at Dundee United, Aberdeen beat Dundee, Kilmarnock won against Ayr United, while League One Ross County shocked Dunfermline.

items.title: Sheff Utd & Birmingham draw a blank on opening day
items.description: Sheffield United and Birmingham made an underwhelming start to the Championship season as they played out a goalless draw at Bramall Lane.

items.title: Rashford returns as Amorim's Milan highlight issues for Carrick
items.description: Manchester United finish their pre-season campaign with a 4-2 defeat by Ruben Amorim's AC Milan in Poland, as Marcus Rashford returns to Red Devils action.
